summary.text: David Wood, a Libertarian Party candidate and retired computer programmer from Westminster, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Colorado's 8th Congressional District to Manny Rutinel.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Wood is a retired computer programmer who lives in Westminster, Colorado, with his wife, Betsy.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he said he was running on a less interventionist foreign policy, free trade, and limits on executive power.
He received 3.9% of the vote to Manny Rutinel's 55.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
